events.title: Life Drawing - 16 September
events.location: Mint Art House, 87 West Burleigh Road
events.description: This unguided two hour life drawing session offers a great opportunity to practice drawing from a live model, ideal for all skill levels. Join us and refine your creative skills in a relaxed, welcoming environment. events.title: We Are Not Aligned - Exhibition by Shiloh Perry
events.location: Mint Art House, 87 West Burleigh Road
events.description: Come join us for the opening event of Shiloh’s solo exhibition “We Are Not Aligned” on Saturday 19th September. My hand wasn’t there and my eye didn’t see A misalignment in life My body has forgotten my mind A communication breakdown Reality of a past gone A feeling that something is broken Chaos without a voice A ripple trying to escape Something inside…..
